I have been farming this land for many years, and I know beans do not need chemical fertilizer like maize does—they fix their own nitrogen. I will spread some compost and manure from my household onto this plot to keep the soil strong, and I will plant the bean seeds I saved from last season. This plot is small, so my children and I can manage the weeding and harvesting ourselves without hiring ganyu labor, and we rely on the rains just as we always have.
